candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. Im get fever for 2 days. Im temperature na 38.0°C. Im get high risk for malaria. Malaria test dey, dem do am and e show negative. Dem no see any obvious reason for the fever. Dem no see generalized rash. Dem no see cough or difficult breathing. Dem no see diarrhoea. Dem no see ear wahala. Dem no see red eyes. Dem no see runny nose. Dem no get stiff neck. Dem no get cough wey dey follow measles. Dem no get measles for last 3 months. Dem no see say pikin dey convulse now. Dem no see say pikin don convulse before. Dem no see say pikin dey lethargic or unconscious. Dem no see say pikin no fit drink or breastfeed. Dem no see say pikin dey vomit everything. Dem see identified bacterial cause for this fever.
